format: PUW gsc_phone per-contact wants-battle chances — extracted from held pokecrystal caller scripts (staging prep; drop-in for the Johto bind).
consumption: Join on (name, map_slug) against phone_contact_tier_mapping.json contacts[] — the same join the gsc_phone bind adapter performs (code_prep_gsc_phone/tests/gsc_phone_tests.gd _contacts()). Copy wants_battle_chance onto each runtime contact dict, exactly as that adapter already does for JACK/JOEY/PARRY. Contacts with wants_battle_chance == null are the four unwired contacts: the field is not consumed for them (see fallback_if_field_required).
mechanism_summary: Crystal has no per-contact chance table. The chance is computed from each contact's own caller script (engine/phone/scripts/<name>.asm, the <Name>PhoneCallerScript registered in data/phone/phone_contacts.asm): a sequence of uniform PhoneScript_RandomN draws (generic_callee.asm:1-21: random N, uniform 0..N-1) and flag checks on the path to the label that setflags ENGINE_<NAME>_READY_FOR_REMATCH. The extracted value is the exact probability that one connected caller-script execution reaches that label.
baseline_conditions: ENGINE_<NAME>_READY_FOR_REMATCH clear (the profile only rolls content for a not-ready contact; an already-ready contact's call is generic content in the source too).

The contact's persistent blocker flags (weekday-flavor flags and has-item flags listed per contact) clear. While any is set, the source diverts the call before the battle draw and the chance for that call is 0. Weekday-flavor flags are set by the contact's callee script when the player calls them at the named weekday/time; has-item flags are set by the caller item branch itself and cleared when the player collects the item in person.
For the computed contacts, the story-progression inputs named in baseline_conditions are in the state that opens the battle branch (headline value); variant_values give the value in the other states.
rounding: wants_battle_chance is the integer percent the profile compares a 0..99 content roll against (roll < chance). It is round-half-up(exact fraction x 100). The exact fraction is always recorded alongside; non-representable fractions lose at most 0.5pp (1/3 -> 33, 2/3 -> 67, 3/16 -> 19, 5/33 -> 15).

contacts.name: JACK
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 != 0) x P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2 x 1/2. First Random2 gate: outcome 0 diverts to JackBattleTrivia (call ends, no battle). Second Random2: outcome 0 jumps to JackWantsToBattle, which setflags ENGINE_JACK_READY_FOR_REMATCH.
blocker_flags_zero_the_chance: ENGINE_JACK_MONDAY_MORNING set => battle branch unreachable (diverts to .WaitingForBattle)

contacts.name: BEVERLY
contacts.formula: Caller script has exactly one random branch: Random4 outcome 0 (1/4) sets ENGINE_BEVERLY_HAS_NUGGET and plays the found-item call; all other outcomes are generic calls. There is NO battle branch, NO *_READY_FOR_REMATCH flag for Beverly anywhere in constants/engine/maps (grep-verified), and wBeverlyFightCount is '; unreferenced' in ram/wram.asm:3233. Crystal therefore defines no readiness chance for Beverly at all.

fallback_if_field_required.reason: No Crystal readiness chance exists for this contact (no battle branch / no READY flag in source). The gsc_phone profile does not consume wants_battle_chance for unwired contacts at all: readiness comes from the labeled PUW-side rule (via: puw_unwired_rule) established in code_prep_gsc_phone. If a bind tool insists on an integer, 25 is the profile default (PHONE_DEFAULT_WANTS_BATTLE_CHANCE) and must be recorded as a PUW default, never as a sourced Crystal value.

contacts.name: HUEY
contacts.formula: P = P(Random3 in {0,1}) = 2/3. Single Random3 draw; outcomes 0 and 1 both jump to HueyWantsBattle.

contacts.name: GAVEN
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2. Single Random2 draw; outcome 0 jumps to GavenWantsRematch (setflags ENGINE_GAVEN_READY_FOR_REMATCH).

contacts.name: BETH
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2.

contacts.name: JOSE
contacts.formula: P = P(Random3 == 0) = 1/3. If the battle draw fails, a second Random3 decides the Star Piece item call instead; it cannot also reach the battle label.
blocker_flags_zero_the_chance: ENGINE_JOSE_HAS_STAR_PIECE set => .Generic (until the item is collected in person)

contacts.name: REENA
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2.

contacts.name: JOEY
contacts.formula: P = P(Random3 in {0,1}) = 2/3.

contacts.name: WADE
contacts.formula: Baseline P = P(Random2 != 0) [berry-item gate passed over] x P(Random2 == 0) [battle gate] = 1/2 x 1/2 = 1/4. Computed inputs: (a) ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD must be set, else the battle gate is never reached (chance 0); (b) on a Bug-Catching-Contest weekday (Tue/Thu/Sat) with ENGINE_DAILY_BUG_CONTEST clear, the call first passes an extra Random2 gate (outcome 0 falls into .NoContest; outcome != 0 with the contest checks passed ends the call as the contest announcement), halving the chance to 1/8.
baseline_conditions: ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD set (story progression); baseline weekday = non-contest day, or ENGINE_DAILY_BUG_CONTEST already set
blocker_flags_zero_the_chance: ENGINE_WADE_HAS_ITEM set => .next (generic) until the berry is collected in person

variant_values.condition: Bug-Catching-Contest weekday (Tue/Thu/Sat) and ENGINE_DAILY_BUG_CONTEST clear, flypoint open

contacts.name: RALPH
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2, but only reachable when ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD is set; without it the caller script goes straight to .CheckSwarm (Qwilfish swarm / generic) and the chance is 0. Computed input: ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD.

contacts.name: LIZ
contacts.formula: P = P(Random4 != 0) [wrong-number gate: outcome 0 ends the call as LizWrongNumber] x P(Random2 != 0) [gossip gate: outcome 0 diverts to LizGossip] x P(Random2 == 0) [battle gate] = 3/4 x 1/2 x 1/2 = 3/16, and the battle gate is only reached when ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD is set (else .Generic; chance 0). Source quirk, recorded verbatim: Liz's READY and ENGINE_LIZ_THURSDAY_AFTERNOON checks both jump to .next, which is the immediately following line, so neither flag actually blocks her battle branch (unlike every other contact).

contacts.name: ANTHONY
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2, reachable only when ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD is set; without it the script goes to .TriesSwarm (Dunsparce swarm / generic) and the chance is 0. Computed input: ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD.

contacts.name: TODD
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2, reachable only when ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD is set; without it the script falls to .NoGoldenrod (rare/generic) and the chance is 0. Computed input: ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD.
blocker_flags_zero_the_chance: ENGINE_TODD_SATURDAY_MORNING set => .TryForSale (dept-store sale / generic), no battle roll

contacts.name: GINA
contacts.formula: Baseline (EVENT_GINA_GAVE_LEAF_STONE not yet set) P = P(Random2 != 0) [Leaf Stone gate passed over; outcome 0 makes this an item call] x P(Random11 != 0) [second Leaf Stone gate] x P(Random3 == 0) [battle gate] = 1/2 x 10/11 x 1/3 = 5/33. Computed inputs: (a) ENGINE_FLYPOINT_GOLDENROD must be set, else .Generic (chance 0); (b) once EVENT_GINA_GAVE_LEAF_STONE is set, the script enters at .GaveLeafStone and skips the first Random2, so the chance becomes 10/11 x 1/3 = 10/33 (integer 30); (c) while ENGINE_ROCKETS_IN_RADIO_TOWER is set, every call is the Rocket rumor and the chance is 0.
blocker_flags_zero_the_chance: ENGINE_GINA_HAS_LEAF_STONE set => .Generic until the stone is collected in person

variant_values.condition: EVENT_GINA_GAVE_LEAF_STONE set (and flypoint open, rockets clear)

contacts.name: IRWIN
contacts.formula: Caller script contains NO random draw at all: it checks ENGINE_ROCKETS_IN_RADIO_TOWER and jumps to the Rocket rumor script, otherwise to the plain rumor script. No battle branch, no ENGINE_IRWIN_READY_FOR_REMATCH flag (grep-verified), wIrwinFightCount '; unreferenced' in ram/wram.asm:3246. No readiness chance exists in Crystal.

contacts.name: ARNIE
contacts.formula: P = P(Random2 == 0) = 1/2. If the draw fails the call continues to the Yanma swarm / rare / generic branches, none of which can loop back to the battle label.

contacts.name: ALAN
contacts.formula: P = P(Random3 == 0) = 1/3. The battle gate is the first draw; the Fire Stone branches (Random2 / Random11 after EVENT_ALAN_GAVE_FIRE_STONE) are only reached when the battle draw fails, so the gave-event does not change the battle chance.
blocker_flags_zero_the_chance: ENGINE_ALAN_HAS_FIRE_STONE set => .Generic until the stone is collected in person

No battle branch, no ENGINE_DEREK_READY_FOR_REMATCH flag (grep-verified), wDerekFightCount '; unreferenced' in ram/wram.asm:3251. No readiness chance exists in Crystal.
